description: Source code for a filesystem-based version store managing note snapshots, including functions for saving, listing, and retrieving note versions, with JSON serialization and atomic file operations.

classes.name: VersionRecord
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a single note version record with id, timestamp, message, and snapshot.

methods.name: _utc_now_iso
methods.description: Returns current UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format with 'Z' suffix.

methods.name: get_versions_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where note version files are stored, configurable via environment variable.

methods.name: _note_file_path
methods.description: Constructs the filesystem path for a note's version JSON file based on note ID.

methods.name: _ensure_parent_dir
methods.description: Ensures the parent directory of a given path exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: _atomic_write_json
methods.description: Atomically writes a JSON object to a file, using a temporary file and replace to prevent partial writes.

methods.name: _load_note_versions_file
methods.description: Loads and parses the JSON file containing note versions, returning a list of VersionRecord and raw data.

methods.name: _make_version_id
methods.description: Generates a unique-ish version ID based on note ID and current timestamp.

methods.name: save_version
methods.description: Saves a new version of a note, appending it to the note's JSON file atomically.

methods.name: list_versions
methods.description: Returns all versions of a note in reverse chronological order (newest first).

methods.name: get_version
methods.description: Retrieves a specific version of a note by version ID, or None if not found.
